description: This file defines the NotesRepository class, which manages CRUD operations and data observation for notes in the application. It acts as a data access layer interfacing with NotesDatabase and Note DAO.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A singleton class providing access to note data, including CRUD operations and observation methods, interfacing with the NotesDatabase and Note DAO.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits all notes stored in the database.

methods.name: observeSearch
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits notes matching the search query.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspended function to retrieve a note by its ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Suspended function to add a new note with the given title and content, setting createdAt and updatedAt timestamps.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Suspended function to update an existing note identified by ID with new title and content.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Suspended function to delete a note by its ID.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of NotesRepository, creating it if necessary in a thread-safe manner.
